means: Subject dead in the middle of the frame with equal air on both sides - formal, confrontational, symmetrical.
does: Appears to work, but only because it agrees with what the model was going to do anyway. In the thirds_bias sweep the center panel is indistinguishable from the seven panels that asked for something else, and SDXL centres a solo subject by default at every shot size. So the tag has no measurable effect of its own; it just fails to disagree. It also duplicates shot.comp.balance symmetrical, so the two cards ship the same picture.
reach_for_it: as documentation, when you want the record to say this frame is meant to be formal and head-on. Not as a lever - it costs prompt tokens against a 75-token budget and buys nothing the default was not already giving you.
used_in: the center option of shot.comp.thirds_bias ("centered composition, subject in the middle") and, in another phrasing, shot.comp.balance symmetrical
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
